classification.referrer_rule: Query strings and fragments are stripped. Email-bearing referrers are stored as a hash.
classification.retention: Clicks are purged through POST /api/v1/compliance/purge using click_retention_days.

findings.message: Query strings and fragments are stripped. Email-bearing referrers are stored as a hash.
Redirecting a browser to a caller-supplied http(s) URL is the product. The javascript scheme, data, file, and embedded credentials are rejected at create time.
Anyone who knows a code can read stats and disable the link. Generated codes are high entropy. Custom aliases are not a security boundary.
